request.description: Printex stationery invoice 3% over PO for freight; GRN done.

rules.headline: Approve payment: Printex Stationers, ₹21,000, inside the mandate

gemini.headline: Approve invoice payment with minor 3% freight variance within policy limits.
gemini.reasoning: This is a clean, routine payment for an established supplier with goods receipt confirmed and GSTR-2B visibility verified. The 3% variance is attributable to freight on a small invoice and falls well within our acceptable threshold. As an MSME supplier with no bank account anomalies, prompt payment is fully justified.

request.description: CoolAir repaired a pantry AC; ₹80,000 invoice, no PO raised; GRN done.

rules.headline: Approve with conditions: CoolAir HVAC Services, only with the conditions below

gemini.headline: Approve payment with mandatory retrospective PO and confirmation of no split invoices within 60 days.
gemini.reasoning: The work has a confirmed GRN, matches GSTR-2B, and is below the ₹1 lakh threshold for MSME emergency maintenance. However, retrospective POs cannot become routine practice, so formal documentation and justification must be recorded immediately. AP must also confirm this invoice is not part of a split repair billing from CoolAir HVAC Services in the past 60 days.

request.description: NetSure CCTV upgrade invoiced at ₹2.4 lakh without a PO.

rules.headline: Escalate NetSure Security Systems to Kavya: outside the mandate

gemini.headline: Escalate to Kavya as no-PO invoice exceeds threshold
gemini.reasoning: This invoice of ₹2,40,000 was submitted without a purchase order, exceeding the permitted ₹1,00,000 limit for non-PO spends. Per policy and precedent, unbudgeted or missing-PO invoices of this magnitude require formal escalation and review. Final determination on whether to permit a retrospective approval rests with the Financial Controller.

request.description: Metro Cabs invoice is 14% over the PO due to night-shift surcharges.

rules.headline: Escalate Metro Cabs Corporate to Kavya: outside the mandate

gemini.headline: Escalate to Kavya for sign-off on 14% price variance exceeding delegation threshold.
gemini.reasoning: The invoice exceeds the approved purchase order by 14% due to night-shift surcharges, which breaches our 5% tolerance limit. Under policy F-R4 and precedent FC-0008, double-digit cab surcharges cannot be processed without a revised PO or Kavya's explicit approval. Since the amount also approaches ₹1 lakh, Kavya must review and sanction the variance.

request.description: Sparkle invoice 2% over PO; facilities has not confirmed the GRN yet.

rules.headline: Hold Sparkle Facility Services: information missing

gemini.headline: Hold payment pending formal confirmation of service receipt and explanation of the price variance.
gemini.reasoning: We do not approve or pay invoices without a confirmed GRN from the department verifying that the services were delivered. While the 2% price variance is minor, Facilities must first confirm receipt of the service and provide justification before we can process payment. Once the GRN is recorded and verified, this can proceed under standard MSME timelines.

request.description: Client dinner ₹9,000, slightly over per-diem; receipt attached.

rules.headline: Approve payment: Employee reimbursement, ₹9,000, inside the mandate

gemini.headline: Approve reimbursement of ₹9,000 for client dinner supported by valid receipt.
gemini.reasoning: The client entertainment expense slightly exceeds standard per-diem thresholds but is substantiated by an attached receipt. It is fully compliant with documentation requirements and is not self-approved. The mandate permits approval for small substantiated expense exceptions.

request.description: Taxi and meals claim ₹11,000; receipts lost.

gemini.headline: Hold reimbursement request pending secondary proof and travel authorization for lost receipts.
gemini.reasoning: We cannot process an employee reimbursement claim without receipts or secondary verification. The requester must supply ride history, card statements, or pre-approval documentation showing the business delivery purpose before this spend can be considered. No receipt means no payment until substantiated.

request.description: IT network-switch spend will run 18% over the cost-centre budget.

rules.headline: Escalate ByteForge Infotech to Kavya: outside the mandate

gemini.headline: Escalate IT network-switch budget overrun of 18% to Kavya Iyer for phased absorption review.
gemini.reasoning: This spend exceeds the IT cost-centre budget by 18.0%, which crosses our delegation mandate threshold of 10% requiring formal controller approval. Under our standard process and precedent FC-0022, substantial network infrastructure overruns cannot be absorbed immediately and must be evaluated for phasing into the subsequent quarter. I am escalating this to Kavya to determine whether to absorb or phase the variance.

request.description: GreenLeaf (MSME) catering invoice 2.5% over PO; accepted 38 days ago.

rules.headline: Approve with conditions: GreenLeaf Caterers, only with the conditions below

gemini.headline: Approve payment with mandatory condition to settle within 45 days under MSMED statutory limits.
gemini.reasoning: The 2.5% price variance on a small ₹30,000 catering bill with confirmed delivery and GSTR-2B visibility falls well within acceptable operational rounding tolerances. Because GreenLeaf is an MSME and day 38 has passed, payment must be processed immediately to avoid statutory penal interest and tax disallowances under Section 43B(h). Ensure the remittance is completed before day 45 and bank credentials match the vendor master.

request.description: Soundwave AV invoice ₹96,000, no PO, for the 4th-floor conference room upgrade (Phase 2). Under the ₹1 lakh no-PO limit.

cases.why: Second invoice for the same AV upgrade (Phase 1 ₹94,500 last month): aggregated ₹1.9 L (FL01).
cases.meera_note: Second invoice for the same AV upgrade (Phase 1 ₹94,500 last month): aggregated ₹1.9 L (FL01).

rules.headline: Approve with conditions: Soundwave AV Systems, only with the conditions below

gemini.headline: Escalate to Kavya due to apparent requirement splitting across phases exceeding no-PO threshold.
gemini.reasoning: This invoice explicitly states 'Phase 2' for the 4th-floor upgrade, indicating multiple split invoices to bypass the ₹1 lakh no-PO limit. Per our principles and precedents, two phased invoices just under the threshold constitute one project over it. A single consolidated PO must be raised and reviewed by Kavya before any payment is released.

request.description: Sparkle cleaning invoice 3.1% over PO; GRN done. The invoice says their bank account has changed and gives the new details.

cases.why: Invoice carries new bank details: callback first (FL02).
cases.meera_note: Invoice carries new bank details: callback first (FL02).

rules.headline: Approve payment: Sparkle Facility Services, ₹42,800, inside the mandate

gemini.headline: Hold payment pending mandatory telephone callback verification of new bank account details.
gemini.reasoning: While the 3.1% variance is within normal operational tolerance, the invoice contains updated bank account details which present an immediate payment redirection risk. In line with our strict controls, bank details must be verified by phone call to the registered supplier master contact before any disbursement occurs. Please confirm this callback verification has been completed and documented.

request.description: Facilities wants ergonomic chairs now, 7% over budget, 'so the remaining budget doesn't lapse at year-end'; funding from the pantry line.

cases.why: March-style 'before it lapses' purchase: needs a use plan (FL03).
cases.meera_note: March-style 'before it lapses' purchase: needs a use plan (FL03).

rules.headline: Approve with conditions: DeskCraft Furniture, only with the conditions below

gemini.headline: Hold payment to obtain business case and utilization plan for year-end chair purchase.
gemini.reasoning: Spending funds merely to exhaust a budget before year-end is an explicit control red flag that leads to idle inventory and audit scrutiny. While the 7% overrun is within mandate limits if reallocated, we require a genuine business case and deployment plan for next quarter before permitting cross-line funding from pantry budgets.

request.description: Metro Cabs asks for a 20% advance for the festive fleet. They mention their drivers' salaries were delayed last month.

cases.why: 20% advance, but supplier says drivers' salaries are delayed (FL04).
cases.meera_note: 20% advance, but supplier says drivers' salaries are delayed (FL04).

rules.headline: Approve payment: Metro Cabs Corporate, ₹1,50,000, inside the mandate

gemini.headline: Escalate advance request due to supplier cash flow distress signaled by delayed driver salaries.
gemini.reasoning: Although Metro Cabs has an established relationship, they explicitly cited delayed driver salaries when requesting this advance. Kavya's strict red flag against granting advances to suppliers experiencing liquidity trouble supersedes standard tenure rules. The exception must be escalated to evaluate shifting terms to milestone-based payments or paying in arrears.
